views.name: membership_credit_period_balances
views.definition:
SELECT p.id,
    p.membership_id,
    p.period_start,
    p.period_end,
    p.credits_allocated,
    p.is_unlimited,
    count(b.id) AS credits_used,
        CASE
            WHEN p.is_unlimited THEN NULL::bigint
            ELSE p.credits_allocated - count(b.id)
        END AS credits_remaining
   FROM membership_credit_periods p
     LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.credit_period_id = p.id AND b.redemption_source = 'membership_credit'::text AND (b.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'confirmed'::text, 'completed'::text, 'no-show'::text]))
  GROUP BY p.id;

views.name: membership_current_credits
views.definition:
SELECT p.membership_id,
    p.id AS period_id,
    p.period_start,
    p.period_end,
    p.is_unlimited,
    p.credits_allocated,
    COALESCE(u.used, 0::bigint)::integer AS credits_used,
        CASE
            WHEN p.is_unlimited THEN NULL::bigint
            ELSE GREATEST(p.credits_allocated - COALESCE(u.used, 0::bigint), 0::bigint)
        END::integer AS credits_remaining
   FROM membership_credit_periods p
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS used
           FROM bookings b
          WHERE b.credit_period_id = p.id AND b.redemption_source = 'membership_credit'::text AND b.status <> 'cancelled'::text) u ON true
  WHERE (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London'::text)::date >= p.period_start AND (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London'::text)::date <= p.period_end;

functions.name: allocate_membership_credit_periods
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.allocate_membership_credit_periods()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  today date := (now() at time zone 'Europe/London')::date;
  inserted integer := 0;
begin
  with eligible as (
    select cm.id as membership_id, cm.start_date, cm.cancel_effective_date,
           p.sessions_included, p.is_unlimited,
           -- whole months elapsed since start (anchored to start day), never negative
           greatest(0,
             (extract(year from age(today, cm.start_date))::int * 12
              + extract(month from age(today, cm.start_date))::int)) as n
    from customer_memberships cm
    join membership_plans p on p.id = cm.plan_id
    where cm.start_date is not null
      and cm.start_date <= today
      and (
        cm.subscription_status = 'active'
        or (cm.subscription_status = 'cancelled' and cm.cancel_effective_date >= today)
      )
  ), periods as (
    select membership_id, sessions_included, is_unlimited, cancel_effective_date,
           (start_date + make_interval(months => n))::date as period_start,
           ((start_date + make_interval(months => n + 1))::date - 1) as period_end
    from eligible
  ), ins as (
    insert into membership_credit_periods
      (membership_id, period_start, period_end, credits_allocated, is_unlimited)
    select membership_id, period_start,
           least(period_end, coalesce(cancel_effective_date, period_end)),
           case when is_unlimited then 0 else coalesce(sessions_included, 0) end,
           is_unlimited
    from periods
    where period_start <= today and period_end >= today
    on conflict (membership_id, period_start) do nothing
    returning 1
  )
  select count(*) into inserted from ins;
  return inserted;
end;
$function$

functions.name: band_for_session_start

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.band_for_session_start(p_start timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT r.band_id
  FROM band_rules r
  WHERE r.day_of_week = EXTRACT(DOW FROM (p_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))::SMALLINT
    AND (p_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::TIME >= r.from_time
    AND (p_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::TIME <  r.to_time
  LIMIT 1
$function$

functions.name: flag_uncovered_credit_bookings
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.flag_uncovered_credit_bookings(p_membership_id uuid, p_covered_through date)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE n integer;
BEGIN
  WITH upd AS (
    UPDATE bookings b
    SET status = 'payment_needed',
        payment_due_by = LEAST(
          now() + interval '72 hours',
          ((b.start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London')),
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE b.redeemed_membership_id = p_membership_id
      AND b.redemption_source = 'membership_credit'
      AND b.status = 'confirmed'
      AND (b.start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date > p_covered_through
      AND (b.start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London')
    RETURNING 1)
  SELECT count(*) INTO n FROM upd;
  RETURN n;
END $function$

functions.name: generate_upcoming_sessions
lapse_sweep_expired_bookings
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lapse_sweep_expired_bookings()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE n integer := 0; r record;
BEGIN
  FOR r IN
    SELECT b.id, b.session_id, b.party_size
    FROM bookings b
    WHERE b.status = 'payment_needed' AND b.payment_due_by <= now() AND COALESCE(b.price_paid, 0) = 0
    FOR UPDATE OF b
  LOOP
    UPDATE bookings SET status = 'cancelled', cancelled_at = now(), cancel_reason = 'membership_lapsed', updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = r.id;
    UPDATE sessions SET total_booked = GREATEST(total_booked - r.party_size, 0), updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = r.session_id;
    n := n + 1;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN n;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pass_covers_session(p_pass_type_id uuid, p_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE((
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN s.type <> 'public' OR s.band_id IS NULL THEN false
      WHEN spt.level = 'all_access' THEN true
      ELSE COALESCE((
        SELECT t.credit_eligible FROM public.membership_band_terms t
        WHERE t.membership_level = spt.level AND t.band_id = s.band_id
      ), false)
    END
    FROM public.session_pass_types spt
    CROSS JOIN public.sessions s
    WHERE spt.id = p_pass_type_id AND s.id = p_session_id
  ), false);
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.plan_seat_terms(p_plan_id uuid, p_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(credit_eligible boolean, discount_percent numeric, list_price numeric, unit_price numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(t.credit_eligible, false),
         COALESCE(t.discount_percent, 0),
         b.price,
         ROUND(b.price * (1 - COALESCE(t.discount_percent, 0) / 100), 2)
  FROM public.sessions s
  JOIN public.session_bands b ON b.id = s.band_id
  JOIN public.membership_plans mp ON mp.id = p_plan_id
  LEFT JOIN public.membership_band_terms t ON t.membership_level = mp.level AND t.band_id = s.band_id
  WHERE s.id = p_session_id AND s.type = 'public';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reassign_session_bands(p_from timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_count INTEGER;
BEGIN
  UPDATE sessions s
  SET band_id = band_for_session_start(s.start_time)
  WHERE s.type = 'public'
    AND s.band_overridden = false
    AND s.start_time >= p_from
    AND s.band_id IS DISTINCT FROM band_for_session_start(s.start_time);

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_count = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN v_count;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.release_event_places(p_event_id uuid, p_places integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
  UPDATE public.events SET places_booked = GREATEST(places_booked - p_places, 0), updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = p_event_id;
$function$
